items.description: Security hardening: fail2ban, UFW firewall rules, sysctl kernel params, SSH hardening
items.notes: Fixed 3 issues: (1) Cat-4 Ordering: fail2ban service was started before its jail.local config was deployed — reordered so template comes before service start. (2) Cat-2 Missing guard: fail2ban install/config/service tasks were not gated by nginx_multisite_fail2ban_enabled — added when: nginx_multisite_fail2ban_enabled | bool to all three tasks. (3) Cat-2 Missing guard: /etc/ssh/sshd_config lineinfile tasks had no check that openssh-server is installed — added stat pre-check and when: nginx_multisite_sshd_config_stat.stat.exists + create: false to both SSH hardening tasks.

items.description: nginx install, global config, security snippet, document root dirs and index.html files
items.notes: Fixed 1 issue: Cat-1 Missing prerequisite: sites-available and sites-enabled directories were never explicitly created. On RHEL/EL the nginx package does not create these directories (unlike Debian/Ubuntu), but the role declares EL support in meta/main.yml. Added explicit ansible.builtin.file tasks to create both directories before the service is started and before sites.yml creates symlinks into them.

items.description: SSL: fetch Conjur passphrase, create ssl-cert group, generate self-signed certs for all three vhosts
items.notes: No issues found. Package install precedes all file operations. ssl-cert group is created before the private key directory uses it as group owner. Cert/key generation is properly guarded by stat checks. changed_when: true is correct since the task only runs when certs are absent.

items.description: Deploy vhost configs, create sites-enabled symlinks, remove default site for all three vhosts
items.notes: No issues found. sites-available and sites-enabled directories are now guaranteed to exist (created in nginx.yml). Template vars are correctly placed at task-level vars: not as module parameters. Symlink creation is idempotent via state: link.
